name: bga-agricola-card-recorder
description: Dev tooling for the BGA Agricola card recorder extension (the extension itself needs no build).

scripts.test: npm run test:replay && npm run test:sim
scripts.test:replay: node tests/replay-test.js > /dev/null && GUESS=A5m:2 node tests/replay-test.js > /dev/null && GUESS=A5m:1 WRONG=1 node tests/replay-test.js > /dev/null && TRAVEL=E25m:1 node tests/replay-test.js > /dev/null && echo 'replay tests OK'
